svg.aria-label: Your task, a config.yaml and a transformations.py, goes into the Ubunye engine, which reads, transforms, writes and keeps a run record. It runs on pandas, Spark, Databricks, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Azure or Docker. The run records from every place match, checked by ubunye prove. It plugs into Airflow, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, MLflow, OpenLineage and Databricks jobs.
svg.desc: Logos: Simple Icons (CC0); marks belong to their owners; OpenTelemetry logo CC BY 4.0, the OpenTelemetry Authors.
